title: Using machine learning for the personalised prediction of revision endoscopic sinus surgery
summary: Models built from clinical records estimated patient-level revision endoscopic sinus surgery risk and evaluated discrimination and predictors in a held-out cohort; this is a retrospective clinical prediction result.
